prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: wrist fracture. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1453; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a collision at an intersection. Insured vehicle was turning left when it struck a vehicle traveling straight through on the opposing approach. Claimant reports a wrist fracture and has retained counsel. All further contact to go through the attorney's office. Photos of both vehicles requested from the insured.

Entry 2: Spoke with insured by phone. Insured states the oncoming vehicle was approaching at speed and the left-turn signal was active. Insured has been asked to provide the dashcam footage and a written statement. Police report requested from the reporting agency.

Entry 3: Received letter of representation from claimant's attorney. Claimant's medical records show a closed fracture of the wrist with surgical fixation performed. Treating physician notes indicate a expected recovery period of several months with physical therapy. Medical bills submitted are under review. Reserve revised to reflect injury severity.

Entry 4: Reviewed police report. Responding officer noted the insured failed to yield to oncoming traffic during the left turn. Witness statement from a pedestrian at the corner supports the claimant's account that the claimant had the green light. Liability appears likely to fall primarily on the insured. Discussed with supervisor.

Entry 5: Demand package received from claimant's attorney, including itemized medical bills, wage loss documentation, and a narrative of ongoing limitations. Demand is being evaluated against policy limits and comparable settlements. Requested an independent medical exam. Scheduled a call with defense counsel to discuss next steps and settlement authority.
